clips.title: The story
paras: Stonebull Lake curves around Bloodhoof Village in central Mulgore, giving the tauren fresh water and fish.

Stonebull Lake curves around Bloodhoof Village on three sides, shaping the heart of central Mulgore. A wooden bridge crosses its narrowest stretch, carrying the main dirt road between the village and Thunder Bluff on the great mesa to the north. Native fish fill the calm water. Hunters rest on the banks, travelers pause there, and apprentice fishers learn their trade beneath the open sky.
